run_marching_cubes_scaled: run marching cubes on a 3D values tensor at a given isolevel and return scaled vertices, faces, and normals
extract_mesh_from_voxel_grid: extract a mesh from a 3D voxel grid tensor using marching cubes with a specified isolevel and voxel extent
extract_mesh_with_mask: extract a mesh from a voxel grid using marching cubes with an optional voxel mask to restrict processing regions
review_marching_cubes_scaled: review the marching_cubes_scaled function that uses scikit-image to extract meshes from 3D scalar fields on CPU
refactor_marching_cubes_scaled: refactor marching_cubes_scaled to support batched inputs instead of the current single 3D tensor limitation
